themes.label: Rejecting AI research for warfare
themes.definition: Rejection of AI research or development for warfare purposes, framed within opposition to the arms race and militarization.
themes.inclusion: Passages opposing military AI, AI for warfare, or AI as part of an arms race.
themes.exclusion: Non-military AI risks or general disarmament passages without AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Arms-race resource arguments count only when AI for warfare is explicitly named.

examples.quote: rejecting the militarization of outer space and research in the area of artificial intelligence for warfare purposes

value.rationale: Single Suriname 2018 passage in which AI appears only as military AI research, rejected as part of opposition to the arms race and militarization.
